description: §17.7.3 — inside `<each in=@items>` over a tape of strings, a bare `@.` is the current item: `${@.}` renders it and `up(@.)` passes it to a function. Two rows: "ab-AB" and "c-C".
rationale: §17.7.3: "Inside the body, `@.` refers to the current item. `@.field` accesses a field of the current item." — `@.` alone is the item itself, valid wherever a value is.
